title: 第二十三章 剧情开始波之国第二十四章
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
几年之中，波风冥帝的各方面的实力，都有了惊人的进展！就算是实战经验，波风冥帝都已经很是丰富！原因便是他经常带着一银制面具，去完成一些任务！
因为波风冥帝明白，忍者经历生死，才可以在短时间之内，提高自己！
终于，波风冥帝具备了“影”的实力！也便是说，他终于要和照美冥告别！
“其实，我有点舍不得你。”波风冥帝望着照美冥，不由得道。看着照美冥的时候，波风冥帝的眼神之中，充满了温柔。
“傻瓜！又不是再也见不到面了。”照美冥美眸望着波风冥帝，四目相对，照美冥感觉自己的心，跳的好快！
这辈子都没有这么快过！
照美冥也知道，波风冥帝是一头苍龙，不该蜗居在雾隐村这小小的地方，他有着更为适合他的天堂！
在照美冥恋恋不舍的目光之中，波风冥帝离开了雾隐村。
。。。。。。同一时间，火之国木叶村，木叶大门。
“好了，我们出发！”黄色头发，长的微微有点狐狸样的鸣人高兴的叫了起来，手舞足蹈。
“你激动什么？”宽额头的小樱埋怨了一声，受不了鸣人。
“因为我啊，从来没有离开过村子。”鸣人一脸笑意的回答道。
看鸣人那傻样子，这次托付木叶任务的委托人达兹纳一脸惊疑！
“哈哈哈，放心没事！有我这个上忍跟着，你完全不用担心。”卡卡西一脸笑意的回答道。而听到达兹纳那句话的鸣人便是不高兴了“你可别小看我，我可是迟早要成为火影的人，我叫漩涡鸣人！”
达兹纳无语，喝着闷酒。
“我已经下定决心了，不管吃多少苦，我也要当上火影！因为这是我的目标，我要让所有人，都认同我的存在。”鸣人最后不由大吼了起来。
“哼，你这小鬼就算当了火影，我也不会认同你的。”达兹纳叹了口气道。
“你说什么？我要杀了你！”鸣人气急败坏的就要冲上去和达兹纳拼了！卡卡西一手拉住了鸣人“喂，鸣人，他可是我们要保护的对象！”
走了一段路！小樱好奇的看着达兹纳问道“达兹纳先生，你是波之国的人吧？”
“恩，怎么了？”达兹纳点了点头，一脸不解。

“既然如此！波之国有忍者吗？”小樱继续问道。卡卡西看达兹纳不想回答，便是说道“不，波之国那是没有忍者的。”然后卡卡西便是将小樱鸣人佐助他们讲了各大国，各大忍者村，以及所谓的五影！
五影是凌驾于忍者世界几万忍者之上的最强忍者！
“真的吗？真的吗？三代火影有那么强？”小樱一脸不相信。鸣人，佐助也同人一脸不信。
“你们这是什么态度!是在怀疑我们的火影大人吗？”卡卡西叹了口气，道！
“没有，没有啊”鸣人和小樱同时摇头。佐助瞥过了头去。
“不过我们木叶忍者村确实有些特别，在木叶忍者中三代火影大人可能不是最强的人。”卡卡西想起来什么。继续说道。
“什么？有人比火影更强？谁啊？谁啊？”鸣人的梦想便是成为火影，在他心目中，谁是火影，谁就是最强，现在居然听卡卡西说有比火影更强的人存在？
content_en:
In the past few years, Emperor Namikaze's strength in all aspects has made amazing progress! Even in terms of actual combat experience, Namikaze Hades is already very rich! The reason is that he often wears a silver mask to complete some tasks!
Because Emperor Namikaze understands that only by experiencing life and death can ninjas improve themselves in a short period of time!
Finally, Namikaze Hades has the power of "shadow"! In other words, he finally has to say goodbye to Terumi Mei!
"Actually, I'm a little reluctant to let you go." Emperor Namikaze couldn't help but said as he looked at Terumi Mei. When looking at Terumi Mei, Namikaze Mei's eyes were full of tenderness.
"Fool! It's not like we'll never see each other again." Terumi Mei looked at Namikaze Emperor with her beautiful eyes, and their eyes met. Terumi Mei felt her heart beating so fast!
It has never gone so fast in my life!
Terumi Mei also knew that Namikaze Mei Emperor was a black dragon and should not live in a small place like Kirigakure Village. He had a paradise that was more suitable for him!
Under Terumi Mei's reluctant eyes, Namikaze Mei Emperor left Kirigakure Village.
. . . . . . At the same time, the Konoha Gate of Konoha Village in the Country of Fire.
"Okay, let's go!" Naruto, who had yellow hair and was slightly fox-like, shouted happily and danced.
"Why are you excited?" Sakura, who had a broad forehead, complained, unable to stand Naruto.
"Because I have never left the village." Naruto replied with a smile on his face.
Seeing Naruto's stupid look, Tatsuna, the client of this mission to Konoha, looked surprised!
"Hahaha, don't worry, it's okay! With me as a Jonin following you, you don't have to worry at all." Kakashi replied with a smile on his face. Naruto was unhappy when he heard what Tazuna said, "Don't underestimate me, I will become Hokage sooner or later. My name is Uzumaki Naruto!"
Dazna was speechless and drank sullenly.
"I have made up my mind, no matter how much hardship I endure, I will become Hokage! Because this is my goal, I want everyone to recognize my existence." Naruto couldn't help but yelled in the end.
"Hmph, even if you brat becomes Hokage, I won't approve of you." Tatsuna sighed.
"What did you say? I'm going to kill you!" Naruto was so angry that he was about to rush forward to fight with Tazuna! Kakashi held Naruto's hand and said, "Hey, Naruto, he is the one we want to protect!"
It’s been a long journey! Sakura looked at Tazuna curiously and asked, "Mr. Tazuna, are you from the Land of Waves?"
"Well, what's wrong?" Dazna nodded, looking confused.
"In that case! Are there ninjas in the Land of Waves?" Sakura continued to ask. Kakashi saw that Tatsuna didn't want to answer, so he said, "No, there are no ninjas in the Land of Waves." Then Kakashi told Sakura, Naruto, Sasuke and the others about the major countries, the major ninja villages, and the so-called Five Shadows!
The Five Shadows are the strongest ninjas that surpass tens of thousands of ninjas in the ninja world!
"Really? Really? Is the Third Hokage that strong?" Sakura looked unbelieving. Naruto and Sasuke also looked disbelieving.
"What is your attitude! Are you doubting our Hokage?" Kakashi sighed and said!
"No, no," Naruto and Sakura shook their heads at the same time. Sasuke glanced away.
"But our Konoha Ninja Village is indeed special. The third Hokage may not be the strongest person among the Konoha Ninjas." Kakashi remembered something. continued.
"What? Someone is stronger than Hokage? Who? Who?" Naruto's dream is to become Hokage. In his mind, whoever is Hokage is the strongest. Now he actually heard Kakashi say that there is someone stronger than Hokage?
